description: This file defines the ProductsController class, which provides REST API endpoints for retrieving products and product-related data from the database in an e-commerce backend. It includes methods for listing all products, fetching a product by ID, and listing products by category.

classes.name: ProductsController
classes.description: Controller class for managing product information via API endpoints in the e-commerce backend.

methods.name: GetProducts
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a list of all products, including their categories.

methods.name: GetProduct
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a single product by its ID, including its category. Returns 404 if not found.

methods.name: GetProductsByCategory
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a list of products filtered by a given category ID, including their categories.
